scope: Synthetic host widget regressions using real Navigator routes and HabitController with a gated MemoryHabitRepository; no production user/device data.
problem: An active record editor covered by another route stayed busy after save completed because cleanup required the editor to be current.
change: Always clear busy state while still mounted. A failed save retains both inputs and mode with the existing error. A successful current editor closes; a successful covered active editor clears committed value/seconds/replacement mode and announces that the record was saved.

oldSourceRegression.observed: After save completed and the cover route was removed, the still-active editor field was disabled in all three cases.

finalValidation.wording: 3 new covered-save cases plus 19 related cases; entry_save_race_test.dart was not part of this targeted command.

newCases: Count increment saved while covered: return to an enabled editor, cleared submitted draft, feedback and a distinct next increment.
Duration replacement saved while covered: return with amount/seconds/mode reset; a next record appends instead of repeating the replacement.
Duration save rejected while covered: original repository/controller remain intact, both inputs and replacement mode survive, one retry succeeds.
preservation: The covering route is not popped by save completion. Historic entry fields and notes persist through successful saves and repository reload. Popped/disposed editor and duplicate callback regressions remain covered by the existing tests.
boundary: This proves host route/persistence behavior. It is not a device or native CI verdict. Full before-source and logs remain in a private local archive.
